02562:     fun compressZip(item: FileItem, customZipName: String? = null) {
02563:         val parentDir = if (item.path.contains('/')) {
02564:             item.path.substringBeforeLast('/').ifEmpty { "/" }
02565:         } else if (item.path.contains('\\')) {
02566:             item.path.substringBeforeLast('\\').ifEmpty { "\\" }
02567:         } else {
02568:             _currentPath.value
02569:         }
02570:         val cleanParent = if (parentDir == "/") "/" else parentDir.trimEnd('/')
02571:
02572:         val rawZipName = customZipName?.ifBlank { null } ?: item.name
02573:         val cleanZipName = if (rawZipName.endsWith(".zip", ignoreCase = true)) {
02574:             rawZipName
02575:         } else {
02576:             "$rawZipName.zip"
02577:         }
02578:
02579:         val targetZipPath = if (cleanParent == "/") "/$cleanZipName" else "$cleanParent/$cleanZipName"
02580:
02581:         val reqIdStr = Random.nextInt(100000, 999999).toString()
02582:         val filesArray = gson.toJsonTree(listOf(item.name))
02583:
02584:         val zipReq = JsonObject().apply {
02585:             addProperty("action", "zip")
02586:             addProperty("path", cleanParent)
02587:             add("files", filesArray)
02588:             addProperty("file", cleanZipName)
02589:             addProperty("dest", cleanZipName)
02590:             addProperty("target", cleanZipName)
02591:             addProperty("output", cleanZipName)
02592:             addProperty("rec", 1)
02593:             addProperty("recurse", 1)
02594:             addProperty("recursive", 1)
02595:             addProperty("includeempty", 1)
02596:             addProperty("emptydirs", 1)
02597:             addProperty("folders", 1)
02598:             addProperty("all", 1)
02599:             addProperty("dirs", 1)
02600:             addProperty("emptyDirs", true)
02601:             addProperty("includeDirs", true)
02602:             addProperty("reqid", reqIdStr)
02603:             addProperty("id", reqIdStr)
02604:         }
02605:
02606:         val totalSize = if (item.size > 0L) item.size else 1024L * 1024L * 5L
02607:
02608:         val progress = TransferProgress(
02609:             fileName = cleanZipName,
02610:             filePath = targetZipPath,
02611:             isUpload = false,
02612:             bytesTransferred = 0L,
02613:             totalBytes = totalSize,
02614:             type = TransferType.COMPRESS
02615:         )
02616:         _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.filter { it.filePath != targetZipPath } + progress
02617:
02618:         val zipSession = ActiveZipSession(
02619:             zipPath = targetZipPath,
02620:             fileName = cleanZipName,
02621:             sourcePath = item.path,
02622:             totalSize = totalSize
02623:         )
02624:         activeZipSessions[targetZipPath] = zipSession
02625:
02626:         _statusMessage.value = "Comprimiendo ${item.name} a $cleanZipName..."
02627:
02628:         val job = scope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
02629:             try {
02630:                 ensureConnected()
02631:                 webSocket?.send(zipReq.toString())
02632:
02633:                 while (isActive && activeZipSessions.containsKey(targetZipPath)) {
02634:                     delay(500)
02635:                 }
02636:             } catch (e: Exception) {
02637:                 Log.e("MeshFilesZip", "Error sending zip request: ${e.localizedMessage}", e)
02638:             }
02639:         }
02640:         zipSession.job = job
02641:     }

02643:     private fun handleZipControlMessage(json: JsonObject) {
02644:         if (activeZipSessions.isEmpty()) return
02645:
02646:         val reqid = json.get("reqid")?.asString ?: json.get("id")?.asString ?: ""
02647:         val rawTargetFile = json.get("file")?.asString ?: json.get("dest")?.asString ?: json.get("target")?.asString ?: ""
02648:         val targetFile = rawTargetFile.trimStart('/')
02649:
02650:         val session = activeZipSessions.values.firstOrNull {
02651:             (reqid.isNotEmpty() && (it.zipPath.contains(reqid) || it.fileName.contains(reqid))) ||
02652:             (targetFile.isNotEmpty() && (
02653:                 it.fileName.contains(targetFile, ignoreCase = true) ||
02654:                 it.sourcePath.contains(targetFile, ignoreCase = true) ||
02655:                 it.zipPath.contains(targetFile, ignoreCase = true) ||
02656:                 targetFile.contains(it.fileName.substringBeforeLast('.'), ignoreCase = true)
02657:             ))
02658:         } ?: activeZipSessions.values.firstOrNull() ?: return
02659:
02660:         val msg = json.get("msg")?.asString ?: ""
02661:         val subaction = json.get("subaction")?.asString ?: ""
02662:         val status = json.get("status")?.asString ?: ""
02663:         val errorMsg = json.get("error")?.asString ?: json.get("err")?.asString
02664:
02665:         if (errorMsg != null || status.equals("error", ignoreCase = true)) {
02666:             val err = errorMsg ?: "Error en compresión ZIP"
02667:             session.job?.cancel()
02668:             _statusMessage.value = err
02669:             _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.filter { it.filePath != session.zipPath }
02670:             activeZipSessions.remove(session.zipPath)
02671:             return
02672:         }
02673:
02674:         val current = json.get("current")?.asLong ?: json.get("bytes")?.asLong ?: json.get("transferred")?.asLong ?: json.get("compressed")?.asLong
02675:         val total = json.get("total")?.asLong ?: json.get("totalBytes")?.asLong ?: json.get("size")?.asLong
02676:         val percent = json.get("progress")?.asFloat ?: json.get("percent")?.asFloat ?: json.get("percentage")?.asFloat
02677:
02678:         val newTotal = total ?: session.totalSize
02679:         session.totalSize = newTotal
02680:
02681:         if (percent != null) {
02682:             val p = if (percent > 1.0f) (percent / 100.0f).coerceIn(0f, 1f) else percent.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
02683:             val calcBytes = (newTotal * p).toLong()
02684:             val monotonicBytes = maxOf(session.bytesCompressed, calcBytes)
02685:             session.bytesCompressed = monotonicBytes
02686:             _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.map {
02687:                 if (it.filePath == session.zipPath) it.copy(bytesTransferred = monotonicBytes, totalBytes = newTotal) else it
02688:             }
02689:         } else if (current != null) {
02690:             val monotonicBytes = maxOf(session.bytesCompressed, current)
02691:             session.bytesCompressed = monotonicBytes
02692:             _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.map {
02693:                 if (it.filePath == session.zipPath) it.copy(bytesTransferred = monotonicBytes, totalBytes = newTotal) else it
02694:             }
02695:         }
02696:
02697:         val isComplete = msg.equals("zippingDone", ignoreCase = true) ||
02698:                 msg.equals("unzippingDone", ignoreCase = true) ||
02699:                 subaction == "complete" || subaction == "end" || subaction == "done" ||
02700:                 status.equals("ok", ignoreCase = true) || status.equals("completed", ignoreCase = true) || status.equals("done", ignoreCase = true) ||
02701:                 json.get("done")?.asBoolean == true || json.get("complete")?.asBoolean == true || json.get("result")?.asString == "ok" ||
02702:                 (percent != null && percent >= 100f)
02703:
02704:         if (isComplete) {
02705:             finishZip(session)
02706:         }
02707:     }

02709:     private fun finishZip(session: ActiveZipSession) {
02710:         session.job?.cancel()
02711:         val zipPath = session.zipPath
02712:         val totalSize = session.totalSize
02713:
02714:         _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.map {
02715:             if (it.filePath == zipPath) {
02716:                 it.copy(bytesTransferred = totalSize, totalBytes = totalSize, isCompleted = true)
02717:             } else it
02718:         }
02719:
02720:         _statusMessage.value = "Compresión finalizada: ${session.fileName}"
02721:
02722:         val parentFolder = if (zipPath.contains('/')) {
02723:             zipPath.substringBeforeLast('/').ifEmpty { "/" }
02724:         } else {
02725:             "/"
02726:         }
02727:
02728:         if (_currentPath.value == parentFolder) {
02729:             listDirectory(parentFolder)
02730:         }
02731:
02732:         scope.launch {
02733:             delay(1200)
02734:             _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.filter { it.filePath != zipPath }
02735:             activeZipSessions.remove(zipPath)
02736:         }
02737:     }

02739:     fun cancelZip(targetFilePath: String? = null) {
02740:         try {
02741:             val key = targetFilePath ?: activeZipSessions.keys.firstOrNull()
02742:             val session = if (key != null) activeZipSessions.remove(key) else null
02743:             val name = session?.fileName ?: "archivo"
02744:
02745:             session?.job?.cancel()
02746:             if (key != null) {
02747:                 _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.filter { it.filePath != key }
02748:             }
02749:             _statusMessage.value = "Compresión cancelada: $name"
02750:         } catch (e: Exception) {
02751:             Log.e("MeshFilesZip", "Error canceling zip compression: ${e.localizedMessage}", e)
02752:         }
02753:     }
